title: First Lessons: Stone
introNarration: Mentor Quern sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of Stone. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Quern.
completionNarration: Quern sets a paw on the keystone. Stone has your name, if not yet your weight.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of Stone.
